It also won 2 electrostatic precipitator (EPS) modeling contracts, both expected to be completed in Q4 2026.

Moreover, a repeat domestic customer awarded Fuel Tech a contract to demonstrate its SNCR technology at a waste incinerator. The demonstration is scheduled for Q3 2026, with potential permanent equipment orders in Q4 2026 if successful.
The latest awards bring the company's announced bookings to $15M year-to-date, while its effective backlog stands at $20M.
Management said it expects additional APC contracts to be awarded over the next 60–90 days and continues to see growth in 2026 across its core products and services.

title: Fuel Tech wins $2.8M worth of APC contracts; backlog hits $20M
